title: Wolppies
description: A resource pack for minecraft that replaces vanilla minecraft villagers with anthropomorphic animals!
body:
# Anthropomorphic villagers are here!
Explore the minecraft world finding new adorable village residents!


## REQUIRES [EMF](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features) AND [ETF](https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures) MOD TO WORK!


 Resource pack comes with custom models for villager types and their professions!

*Currently every villager type appears as the wolf type
 
 Planned

- Wolfs (Plains) ✅
- Lions (Savanna) ➖ (next update)
- Bears (Snowy)
- Lynxes (Taiga)
- Rats (Desert)

(the essential idea)

![Waving wolf](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/de0dea6ded469f8bf024b635d34496a3bf0d6734.png)



- Base wolf model and 5 variants for the plains type villager

![Wolf villager plains type 5 variants](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4b4b5029c6b3aaa4d45bb688b844efe9d33c02b7.png)


- all professions for the plains villagers 
 ![Wolf villager plains type 5 custom professions](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/792b20125080b0ac6deaffae567a42a28b00021f.png)
- Animations
- Sounds for the plains type




Lions coming soon....


![Vilager Lion](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fac166863e19a422c1646e23bfc58733f12a209a.png)
